description: ECHO: Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a free 3D browser game that makes space history easy to learn. Long technical reports hide the stories of the machines NASA left on the Moon and Mars. In ECHO, a student from the future visits them. Walk up to each machine, see it in 3D and a real NASA photo, and hear its story in plain words. Answer one question to save it. Six levels, three on the Moon and three on Mars, follow the missions in order, with sources for every story.
